title.narrative: Post-Earthquake Recovery and Agrifood Support Project

description.narrative:
The Project aims to support the economic recovery of earthquake-affected firms in the agriculture and agrifood sectors and thereby contribute to the enhancement of the food security and productivity. The Project will also strengthen the resilience of the agriculture and agrifood sectors of Türkiye and the country’s preparedness for adapting to climate change and managing future commodity market shocks. The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to support the economic resilience, recovery and productivity enhancement of earthquake-affected firms in the agriculture and agrifood sectors of Türkiye.
The Project outcomes and impacts are expected to contribute to achieving food security, achieving improved nutrition, and promoting sustainable agriculture, by addressing the major issues of timely availability of infrastructure, equipment and agricultural input, especially given that Türkiye is dealing with recovery from the devasting twin earthquakes, high inflation, currency depreciation and the continued responsibility of hosting a large number of refugees.
